text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arabs in Baghdad demonstrate against Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Tunisian president calls for the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- U.S. administration blocked food and medicine deals under oil-for-food pact.
- Sudanese parliament says Iraq has the right to use its civilian planes.
- Some 3,280 combine harvesters take part in this year's harvest in Nineveh province.
- Iraq and Lebanon expand economic and commercial cooperation.
- Editorial says Iraq is aware of Washington's covetous intentions on its oil wealth.
- Commentary says Turkish losses to increase if Turks decide to stay longer in northern Iraq.
- Iraq and France agree on joint agricultural project.
- Article warns Turkey of the consequences of its invasion of northern Iraq.
